title: Seed Auth0 secrets into Infisical and Pages for .agency
description: Populate AUTH0_* secrets in Infisical at /agency/auth or chosen path, sync them to the create-something-agency Pages project, verify /login and /auth/callback in production, and then deploy the Auth0 pivot safely. Current blocker: Pages project has no AUTH0_* secrets and Auth0 CLI is not installed on this machine.

title: Ensure policy-os-engine builds before agency
description:
Agency builds can fail in a clean workspace because @create-something/policy-os-engine exports dist/index.js but is not guaranteed to be built before vite resolves it. Acceptance criteria:
- Reproduce from a clean workspace
- Fix build ordering or exports so pnpm --filter @create-something/agency build succeeds without a manual prebuild
- Verify the relevant workspace build path
